name: adk-libpetri-diagrams
description: Diagram-generation scripts that build the canonical adk-libpetri net topologies via the libpetri npm package and render them to SVG via graphviz.

scripts.build: tsx src/index.ts && for f in dot/*.dot; do dot -Tsvg "$f" -o "svg/$(basename "$f" .dot).svg"; done
